4. **P2 — A slow handshake blocks unrelated lease controls.**  
   [endpoint_lease_manager.ex:274](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/endpoint_lease_manager.ex:274)

   Client startup runs inside the single manager process. An 800 ms handshake delayed revocation of another connection by 671 ms. With the default 30-second handshake, unrelated controls can exceed their five-second call timeout. Session lease checks use those controls.

   **Correction:** Start clients outside the manager callback. Before accepting the result, check the lease and ownership barrier again.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Fixed in 5e107d4b. Client startup no longer blocks lease controls; ownership, expiry, cancellation, and parallel-start tests pass. Full umbrella mix quality and demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 demo tests pass.
